title: Concept: Jenkins script console disclosed
description: The Jenkins script console is served at this endpoint, so the administrative Groovy console is reachable from this network position.
applicability: Responses served by a Jenkins controller.
risk: A caller who can submit the form runs code in the Jenkins controller with its credentials and access to every build secret; HIGH because the console is code execution by design once it is reachable and unauthenticated.
